manuscript_claim: Preprocessed PaddleOCR achieves a 4-fold reduction in Character Error Rate (CER 0.086 vs 0.328) compared to Preprocessed Tesseract on real student handwriting.
The corrected OpenCV 4.5+ MinAreaRect deskew algorithm resolves coordinate convention flips, achieving angular estimation error <= 0.02 deg across +/-10 deg fixtures.
Dual-range HSV red-ink isolation completely eliminates examiner tick and margin grade contamination (0.0% leakage vs 38.5% in raw OCR).
Under an identical frozen rubric grader, raw Tesseract induces a catastrophic 58.78% relative grade penalty (mean Delta = -8.25 marks; QWK collapses to 0.0679).
Preprocessed PaddleOCR closely tracks human oracle grading (MAE 0.67 marks vs Gold, QWK 0.9353 vs Oracle QWK 0.9268) with 0.0 false credit.
statistical_significance: p = 0.84 vs Oracle (statistically indistinguishable from human transcript)

statistical_significance: Conformal 90% empirical coverage validated on locked test
